item.title: Spurs humble Pistons with 114-103 victory in potential NBA Finals preview
item.description: Victor Wembanyama had 21 points, 17 rebounds and six blocks, Devin Vassell scored 28 and the San Antonio Spurs beat the Detroit Pistons 114-103 in a potential NBA Finals preview.

item.title: Deer Park shovelers find man in snow; pronounced dead at scene, Suffolk police say
item.description: The workers discovered the man as they shoveled a walkway at the complex on Parkcenter Drive, the Suffolk County Police Department said.

item.title: Kings end 16-game skid as Westbrook and Achiuwa lead the way in 123-114 win over Grizzlies
item.description: The Sacramento Kings have ended their franchise-worst 16-game losing streak.

item.title: Asian shares are mixed after heavy selling of potential AI losers hits Wall Street
item.description: Shares are mixed in Asia after U.S. stocks slumped on heavy selling of shares in companies that could be losers in the artificial-intelligence boom.

item.title: Munoz, Lane help Grambling pull away for 83-62 victory over Mississippi Valley State
item.description: Antonio Munoz had 21 points and Jimel Lane posted a double-double to help Grambling pull away in the second half and beat Mississippi Valley State 83-62.

item.title: China puts Japanese companies on export control lists as tensions rise
item.description: China has put 20 Japanese companies on an export control list and 20 others on a watchlist, as tensions continue over the Japanese leader's previous comments on Taiwan, the self-governed island Beijing claims as its own.

item.title: White scores 23 as No. 14 Kansas rebounds with 69-56 win over No. 5 Houston
item.description: Tre White scored a season-high 23 points and No. 14 Kansas bounced back from a surprising defeat with a 69-56 victory over No. 5 Houston.

item.title: Air ambulance plunges into eastern India forest, killing 7
item.description: Authorities in eastern India say an air ambulance has crashed into a dense forest, killing all seven people on board.

item.title: Blizzard prompts Boston Globe management to call off printing paper for first time in 153 years
item.description: A record-setting snowstorm has prompted managers of The Boston Globe to call off printing their daily newspaper for the first time in its 153-year-old history.
